source_text: 75. Et le même prophète dit encore, à propos de la passion du Christ: «Toi, tu nous as rejetés, tu nous as dédaignés et tu as repoussé ton Christ. Tu as rompu l'alliance de mon serviteur, tu as souillé à terre sa sainteté. Tu as renversé toutes ses murailles et tu as ébranlé toutes ses forteresses. Ceux qui passaient par le chemin l'ont dépouillé; il est devenu l'opprobre de ses voisins. Tu as élevé la droite de ses oppresseurs; tu as fait la joie de ses ennemis à son sujet. Tu as fait retourner en arrière le secours de son épée et tu ne l'as pas aidé dans le combat. Tu l'as privé de sa splendeur, et tu as jeté par terre son trône. Tu as abrégé les jours de sa vie et tu l'as accablé de honte» (Ps 88, 39-46). Voilà ce que le Christ devait souffrir par la volonté de son Père, le prophète l'a déclaré ouvertement; c'est, en effet, sur la volonté de son Père que le Christ devait endurer sa passion
pass_a_gloss: §75 dual gloss (Armenian-via-French sense) ≠ Pass B running English. Theme: Ps 89: passion by the Father’s will.
pass_b_english: And the same prophet says again concerning Christ’s passion: ‘You have cast us off and scorned us, and you have rejected your Christ. You have broken the covenant of your servant; you have defiled his holiness to the ground. You have overthrown all his walls and shaken all his strongholds. Those who passed by the way have stripped him; he has become the reproach of his neighbors. You have raised the right hand of his oppressors; you have made his enemies rejoice over him. You have turned back the help of his sword and have not aided him in battle. You have deprived him of his splendor and cast his throne to the ground. You have shortened the days of his life and overwhelmed him with shame.’ ([[Ps 89:38-45 >> Bible:Ps 89:38-45]])

That the Christ was to suffer these things by his Father’s will, the prophet has declared openly; for it was upon the will of his Father that the Christ was to endure his passion. ([[Mt 26:39 >> Bible:Mt 26:39]]; [[Acts 2:23 >> Bible:Acts 2:23]]; [[Isa 53:10 >> Bible:Isa 53:10]])
